Hi Sara — thanks for the screenshot, that helps.

We're seeing a small validation mismatch between our Coupa instance and a few non-US VAT formats right now. Two paths forward so we don't block your pilot:

1) Temporary manual vendor creation — if you can send the vendor details below we can create a vendor record on our side and raise a PO manually to your billing contact. This is fastest.
2) We can escalate to Coupa to fix the form validation; it may take 48–72 hours.

Please send the following to proceed with option 1:
- Legal company name (exact)
- Tax / VAT / GST number (format as you normally register)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document (PDF)
- Remittance address
- ACH details or bank authorization (voided check is fine)
- Example invoice (optional but helpful)

I've cc'd Ben and Marissa from Vendor Ops to coordinate. I attached the vendor request form for convenience.

Attachment: vendor_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)

Would you be available for a 30-min call tomorrow morning to walk through?

Cheers,
Maya Srinivasan

Thanks Maya — added a short checklist below for Sara. I've opened an internal Coupa ticket (see link) in case this is a wider validation rule we need changed.

Vendor onboarding checklist (what we need to create a temporary vendor):
- Legal company name (as registered)
- Tax ID / VAT / GST number (full digits, indicate country)
- Complete remittance address (street, city, postal)
- Bank details for ACH (routing + account) or a voided check image
- W-9 / W-8 or equivalent tax certificate (PDF)
- Primary invoicing email and AP contact name/phone
- Sample invoice (optional)

Sara — if you can populate the attached vendor_request_form.pdf and return it along with a voided check we'll create a vendor record and issue a PO. Temporary vendor creation will be marked for review once Coupa validation is fixed.

Coupa ticket: CASE-84762 (vendor field validation)
